member.summary: UI-agnostic, thin facade over for manually triggered update operations. Contains no update logic of its own; thread-safety is inherited from the orchestrator's internal serialization.
member.remarks: Deliberate interface segregation, not an accidental middle man: exposes only the subset of meant for manual, UI-triggered operations (check/download/install), while additionally covers status reads and the full automated workflow used by the background services.
